messages:
anna_fin: FYI invoice INV-3321 from Cascade Tech routed to Engineering approvers instead of Finance. System shows PO missing but vendor put PO field 'N/A' in PDF. Can procurement confirm contract/PO?
raj_procure: Checking. We have a master SOW CT-MA-21, but no formal PO was created for this engagement (procurement gap). Should have been PO-CT-900 created during onboarding.
claire_ap: AP blocked it as 'no_po' and auto-routed to eng-team because original requestor was tagged as eng-product. We usually route no-PO invoices to Finance for manual review. Bug?
finance-bot: Automation note: routing rule R-12: if invoice.no_po==true AND requestor.team==eng -> route to requestor.team unless override_flag=finance_only. Looks like override_flag wasn't set.
anna_fin: (typo) anna_fin: @raj_procure can you confirm whether Cascade will accept invoice without PO or reissue referencing PO-CT-900? We prefer vendor reissue but can do post-facto PO.
vendor-bot: Cascade Tech (billing@cascadetech.com) uploaded INV-3321 (PDF) — link: https://files.example.com/cascade/INV-3321.pdf
raj_procure: I messaged vendor: "Can you reissue with PO-CT-900? If not, reply here confirming the invoice maps to SOW CT-MA-21 and we will create a post-facto PO."
vendor-bot: Vendor replied: "We can reissue quickly with PO-CT-900. Will send revised invoice within 24h."
claire_ap: Great — hold payment and set payment_hold:true. I'll set route to Finance so they can pre-approve for coding once reissue arrives.
finance-bot: Manual override executed by claire_ap: `/route-invoice 1745678902 --to finance-approvals --note "vendor to reissue with PO-CT-900; pre-approve coding"`. Audit entry created.
payments_lead: Noted. Payment hold placed; will not schedule until AP clears and PO matched.
raj_procure: I'll create PO-CT-900 as a post-facto PO template with reference to SOW CT-MA-21 so vendor can reference.
anna_fin: (typo) anna_fin: Thanks everyone. Once reissued invoice arrives we'll do fast match and release. Also logging defect for R-12 routing behavior so future no-PO invoices go to Finance not eng.
finance-bot: Ticket created: T-33421 "routing: no-po invoices from eng should default to finance-override".
claire_ap: Closing loop for now. Will watch for new invoice and pick up matching.
